byok.explain: The AI assistant runs on your own key. Nothing is sent to our servers and you pay the provider directly.
byok.emptyTitle: The AI assistant needs your own key. Everything else works without it.
byok.emptyHint: Get a key from one of these providers. You pay them directly, usually a few cents per email.
byok.noContactData: We never send your contact data to the model, only the names of the fields.

credentials.title: AI keys
credentials.label: Name
credentials.apiKeyOnce: This is the last time you see the key. Afterwards we keep only its last four characters.
credentials.deleteConfirm: Delete the key {label}? Conversations stay, but the assistant stops working until you set another key.
credentials.duplicate: You already have this key saved under the name {label}.

usage.title: Usage
usage.lead: You pay the provider directly, not us. This is how much you have run through them.
usage.month: Last 30 days: {requests, plural, =0 {no requests} one {# request} other {# requests}}, {inputTokens} input and {outputTokens} output tokens
usage.billedExplain: Amounts marked as billed come straight from the provider and are money that was really charged. The rest is an estimate from the public price list and may differ from the invoice.

unit.openrouter_credit: {amount} {count, plural, =0 {OpenRouter credits} one {OpenRouter credit} other {OpenRouter credits}}

usage.noPrice: We do not know the price of this model, so we show token usage only.
usage.providerReportsPrice: The provider billed and reported the price back then, but the app did not store it yet.
usage.showCostTable: Show the costs in a table
usage.costChartUnavailable: We do not chart the daily cost, because for at least one day we do not know the price of the model used.
usage.estimateDisclaimer: The estimate comes from the provider public price list, it is not an invoice. The real bill may differ from it.
usage.longContextCaveat: For some models the estimate only holds for requests up to {threshold} tokens. Above that threshold the provider charges more and the real amount may be higher.
usage.empty: You have not used the AI assistant yet, so there is nothing to count.
usage.showTable: Show the values in a table

panel.title: AI assistant
panel.briefPlaceholder: Invitation to the summer bike sale, 20 % off, valid until the end of August
panel.brand: Brand: {name} (colors and logo from the website)
panel.emptyTitle: Describe what the email should contain.
panel.spendHint: You have spent about {amount} on AI in the last 30 days.
panel.noDraft: The assistant finished, but it did not create an email draft. It replied with this:
panel.noDraftHint: Try again and describe more precisely what the email should contain. If it keeps happening, try a different model in AI settings.

steps.brand: We have colors and the logo
steps.validate: Checking that it can be sent

draft.doneTitle: Done. The draft is in the editor on the left.
draft.backupNote: We saved your original content. If you do not like the draft, we will put it back.
draft.reverted: We put your original content back.

errors.noCredential: To use the AI assistant you need your own key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or OpenRouter. You pay them directly, usually a few cents per email.
errors.invalidKey: {provider} rejected the key as invalid. Check that it was copied in full and that it has not expired.
errors.quota: Your {provider} account is out of credit. Top it up in their console, or switch to another provider.
errors.rateLimited: The provider asked us to wait. We will retry in {seconds} seconds automatically.
errors.ourRateLimited: You have used up the hourly AI request limit ({limit}).
errors.invalidOutput: The model returned something we could not read. We will try once more.
errors.invalidOutputFinal: It failed twice in a row. Try simplifying the brief, or use a different model.
errors.timeout: The model did not respond within {seconds} seconds. A shorter brief sometimes helps.
errors.providerDown: {provider} is having an outage. You can switch to another provider in the meantime.
errors.contextTooLong: The brief is too long for this model.
errors.contentFiltered: The provider refused to process this content.
errors.modelNotFound: {provider} does not know this model. Check the model name in AI settings, or pick another one.
errors.unsupportedParameter: The model at {provider} rejected one of the request parameters. Pick a different model in AI settings, this one does not suit the assistant.
errors.requestFailed: {provider} refused the request. Error code: {code}. Check the key and the model name in AI settings.
errors.unknown: The draft could not be created. Error code: {code}. Try again, and if it keeps happening, send us that code.
errors.saveFailed: The key could not be saved.

brand.title: Project brand
brand.lead: Colors, logo and fonts every email in this project is built from.
brand.definitionIntro: Only what actually shows up in the email can be set here. Derived colors are listed in the table below.
brand.name: Brand name
brand.secondaryHint: Companion to the primary color, a second button for example.
brand.accentHint: Highlight that should catch the eye.
brand.backgroundHint: The area around the content, the canvas.
brand.textHint: Body text. Muted text is derived from it.
brand.logoHint: The logo is picked from the media library. Upload new files there.
brand.logoDialogTitle: Pick a logo from the media library
brand.logoLoadFailed: The media library could not be loaded.
brand.logoLibraryEmpty: There is no image in the media library yet.
brand.themeTitle: What this becomes in the email
brand.themeIntro: The color roles the editor works with. You set five of them directly, the rest is derived.
brand.intro: We will fetch colors and the logo from your website
brand.cta: Fetch colors and logo from a website
brand.slow: The site is slow, we will wait a little longer.
brand.doneTitle: Done. Please check that it fits.
brand.fontNote: In emails we only use fonts that everyone has on their computer. Your corporate font will not display reliably in an email.
brand.historyIntro: The project has one brand, the one above. Every fetch overwrites it; here you can see when we took what and from where.
brand.historyEmpty: You have not fetched anything yet.
brand.emptyTitle: Enter your website address and we will fetch colors and the logo from it.

brandErrors.serverError: This failed on our side, not on your website: our server answered with error {status}. Please try again, and report this code if it keeps happening.
brandErrors.unreachable: We could not reach {url}. Check for a typo and that the site is up.
brandErrors.blocked: This address cannot be fetched. Enter the public address of your website, for example https://bike-shop.com.
brandErrors.logoNotFound: We did not find a logo on the site. Please upload it manually.
brandErrors.robotsDisallowed: The site {host} says automated tools should not fetch it. Please set colors and logo manually.
brandErrors.robotsUnavailable: It was not possible to verify whether the site allows fetching.
brandErrors.notAWebPage: There is no web page at this address.
brandErrors.timeout: The site did not respond in time.
brandErrors.rateLimited: Brand extraction is limited to {limit} attempts per hour.
brandErrors.invalidUrl: The address is not valid. Include https://.
brandErrors.schemeNotAllowed: Only http:// and https:// addresses are supported.
brandErrors.credentialsInUrl: The address must not contain credentials.
brandErrors.portNotAllowed: Only the standard ports 80 and 443 are supported.
brandErrors.redirectLoop: The site redirects in a loop.
brandErrors.tooManyRedirects: The site redirects too many times.
brandErrors.insecureRedirect: The site redirects to an insecure address.

brandWarnings.colors_not_found: We did not find colors on the site, the defaults stay. Please set them by hand above.
brandWarnings.fonts_not_found: We did not recognise the font on the site, the system font stays.
brandWarnings.logo_not_found: We did not find a logo on the site. Upload it to the media library and pick it above.

retention.title: Conversation retention
retention.days: We delete assistant conversations after {days} days.
retention.unlimited: Assistant conversations are kept without a time limit. They stay in the database and in every backup until you delete them manually.
